headline: President Ruto Nominates New Data Commissioner And State CEOs
seoTitle: Ruto Nominates Data Commissioner and Appoints CEOs
metaDescription: President William Ruto has nominated Lydia Sitienei Chelagat for Data Commissioner and appointed five new chief executives to lead state corporations.
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto has nominated Lydia Sitienei Chelagat to serve as the new Data Commissioner.
The nomination has been submitted to the Kenyan Parliament for formal review and consideration.
Five state corporations have received new leadership appointments aimed at enhancing management and service delivery.
aiContextParagraph: President William Ruto of Kenya has initiated a series of leadership changes within the country's public institutions. This announcement includes the nomination of Lydia Sitienei Chelagat as the Data Commissioner, a position now awaiting approval from the legislative branch. Alongside this nomination, the administration has filled five vacant chief executive positions across various state-owned corporations. The selection of Waweru Karanja as the Chief Executive Officer of the Privatization Authority and Wakhungu Patrick Murunga to a leadership role are part of these broader administrative updates. According to official statements, these changes are intended to strengthen the organizational management and overall service delivery capacity of these government entities. The nominations and appointments reflect an ongoing effort by the executive office to restructure state corporations and fulfill key regulatory roles within the national data governance framework.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained visibility through multiple independent media reports following the official presidential announcement regarding executive appointments.
